fields.name: name

fields.name: icon
fields.provenance: required non-zero ('The app has no icon to launch itself'); stored to record.icon_name

fields.name: app_id
fields.provenance: u16; copied to record.app_id (the u16 appid used by System msg 26/27)

fields.name: flags
fields.provenance: bit2 = can't be uninstalled ('The app can't be uninstalled'); applied to record.flags bit1

fields.name: icon_resolver

fields.name: hidden_flags
